name: worm
description: Research, trade, and manage Worm (worm.wtf) prediction markets on Solana from the Cursor agent. Public market data works with no setup; add a Solana key to trade.

WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY.title: Solana wallet private key
WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Base58 Solana private key (Phantom/Solflare export). Optional: leave empty for read-only market data. Signs locally and is never sent to the Worm API. Use a dedicated trading wallet.
